theme_strategy: Primary Light Mode with stark, high-contrast borders (Swiss Brutalist inspired). Dark Mode togglable.

rules: Use monochrome 95% of the time. Colors are reserved for functional signals (scores, active states).
Never use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.

surfaces.cards: bg-white border border-border/40 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-200 ease-out hover:shadow-lg rounded-none sm:rounded-lg
surfaces.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-border/40 backdrop-saturate-150

layouts.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to prevent text collision and provide generous breathing room.

libraries: shadcn/ui (Tables, Tabs, Accordions, Progress, Dialogs, Select, Forms)
@phosphor-icons/react (for all icons due to dense data nature)
recharts (for score history charts over time)

customization.cards: Remove excessive padding for dense data sections, but maintain minimum p-4. Use flat rectangular aesthetics over highly rounded.
customization.buttons: Sharp corners or subtle rounded-md, stark black for primary. Always explicitly set hover states (hover:bg-gray-800 hover:text-white).
customization.forms: Left aligned labels, clear visible borders.

visual enhancers.empty_states: Do not leave blank. Show 'Enter a URL to analyze' with abstract minimal graphical cues.
visual enhancers.charts: Use simple area charts for History. Use monotone primary color for lines to avoid rainbow effect.
visual enhancers.json_ld_viewer: Use dark mode retro-futurist block (Terminal look) for the code snippet to contrast against the light UI.
visual enhancers.textures: Add subtle noise texture to the background in dark mode or hero sections if applicable.

rules: Accordion and Tabs must use smooth height/fade transitions.
Score gauge should animate from 0 to actual score on mount using framer-motion or simple CSS transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Black on white, or white on black.

auth_hero.description: Black and white abstract geometric wall, perfect for the split-pane login screen side panel.

3d libraries and steps.instruction: Do not use 3D libraries (Three.js/R3F) for this specific data-heavy dashboard, as it distracts from the quantitative metrics. Stick to 2D charting with Recharts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js files (JSX) instead of .tsx as per the project requirements.
Integrate Shadcn UI components but adjust the rounded corners to be more 'sharp' (max rounded-md) and borders to be 1px solid.
Ensure the JSON-LD viewer has a 'Copy to Clipboard' button and a 'Download .json' button.
Implement the 'Overall Score Gauge' as a prominent SVG circular progress or a bold typography block.
The 8 dimensions (Answer clarity, Structure, etc.) should be displayed as a dense grid of mini-cards with horizontal progress bars.
The 'History & Comparison Dashboard' should use 'recharts' to plot URL scores over time.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Always use Shadcn.
Do NOT center align the app container. Keep text-alignment natural (left).
Add transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease to interactive elements. Do NOT use transition-all.
Add 'sonner' for toast notifications on actions like 'JSON Copied'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Mobile-First layout rules must be enforced using Tailwind prefixes correctly.
Grid Layout items MUST be direct children of grid containers.
Generous spacing: Use padding like p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid edge collisions.
